name: Zarlman Two-Moons
summary: In central Mulgore, Zarlman Two-Moons guides Bloodhoof Village's spiritual life. While Baine Bloodhoof tends its daily affairs, Zarlman communes with the spirits and guides young tauren through the Rite of Vision.

sections.title: Keeper of the Unseen
sections.body: Zarlman Two-Moons tends the spirits while Baine Bloodhoof commands Bloodhoof Village's defenses and temporal needs. The village looks to Zarlman for harmony with the spirit world. He joins the plains' everyday struggles with the voices of ancestors and honors the Earth Mother and ancestral wisdom.

sections.title: The Rite of Vision
sections.body: Zarlman guides maturing tauren through the Rite of Vision, a traditional trial each must undertake. He teaches initiates to prepare sacred draughts and heed ancestral portents. Young hunters, shamans, and warriors seek their destined path and spirit guides through the rite. Zarlman teaches them that strength on the plains means little without spiritual clarity.

aliases: who is the shaman in bloodhoof
faq.answer: Zarlman Two-Moons guides the spiritual life of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. While Baine Bloodhoof tends the village's practical defense and daily affairs, Zarlman watches over its spiritual well-being and guides young tauren through tribal traditions.

faq.q: What is Zarlman's role in Bloodhoof Village?
faq.answer: Zarlman oversees spiritual affairs, communion with ancestors, and cultural rites in Bloodhoof Village. He complements Baine Bloodhoof's physical leadership and keeps the tribe in balance with nature spirits and ancestors.

faq.q: What is the Rite of Vision?
faq.answer: The Rite of Vision is a traditional passage for young tauren coming of age in Mulgore. Guided by Zarlman, initiates drink a ritual concoction, see visions, and receive guidance from nature spirits.

faq.q: Where can Zarlman Two-Moons be found?
faq.answer: Zarlman Two-Moons can be found in Bloodhoof Village, in central Mulgore within the curve of Stonebull Lake.

faq.q: How does Zarlman relate to Baine Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: Zarlman is Baine Bloodhoof's spiritual counterpart in Bloodhoof Village. Baine leads in physical and martial matters, while Zarlman offers mystical wisdom and watches over the tribe's spiritual balance.

faq.q: Why is the Rite of Vision important to young tauren?
faq.answer: The Rite of Vision marks a tauren's passage into adulthood. It acknowledges the youth as a member of the tribe, reveals their inner spirit guide, and cements their bond with the Earth Mother.

angles.text: As a tauren adventurer, you can look to Zarlman for guidance through the sacred rites of your youth and the awakening of your spiritual sight.
As a shaman, you follow the tauren tradition Zarlman embodies: communion with the spirits alongside practical tribal leadership.
As a Horde ally arriving in Mulgore's central hub, you can learn from Zarlman about the spiritual customs that shape tauren culture.
